page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-8 is a general-purpose server powered by an Intel Xeon CPU running at 2.8 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs.

Performance benchmarks place this server primarily in the average tier. Multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and software compilation with Clang score in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth is stable, reaching 413.79 GB/sec for cached small blocks and around 50.27 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, certain multi-threaded decompression tasks and complex operations like ray tracing and image processing fall into the lower 25% performance tier.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving, the n2-standard-8 is suited for general-purpose workloads. These include web serving, application hosting, and moderate database tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, its dedicated CPU allocation and standard resource density offer a predictable performance profile for steady-state business applications without the overhead of specialized hardware.
description: The Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-8 is a general-purpose server configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, translating to 4.0 GB of memory per core. Powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor operating at 2.8 GHz across 4 physical cores, this instance does not bundle local storage or GPUs. Benchmark results indicate average performance across most standard operations, including software compilation, memory bandwidth, and Redis SET operations, though it exhibits weaker results in multi-threaded decompression and ray tracing. With static web serving throughput reaching 6.9 GB/sec and database operations scoring in the middle tier, this server is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, web serving, and database hosting. It offers a balanced, predictable resource profile for standard business applications.
